data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'fahm' meaning 'understanding' or 'knowledge'. In Islamic tradition, the name Fahmideh represents the pursuit of knowledge and wisdom. The name Fahmideh carries the meaning “Understanding, Knowledge” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fahmideh usually hope their child will grow to embody understanding, knowledge and live with faith, good character and purpose.
